meta.source: gtrack design canvas (dark dashboard direction), HeroUI v3 + HeroUI Native variable names

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every card. HeroUI --background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on background and surfaces. HeroUI --foreground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, accordions, the top nav pills at rest. HeroUI --surface.

tokens.name: surface-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on surface. HeroUI --surface-foreground.

tokens.name: surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Rows and tiles inside a card (Round rows, SG input rows, Level headers). HeroUI --surface-secondary.

tokens.name: surface-tertiary
tokens.usage: Third step: chips at rest, range pills, kbd. HeroUI --surface-tertiary.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, dropdowns, sheets, toasts. HeroUI --overlay.

tokens.name: overlay-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on overlay. HeroUI --overlay-foreground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, units, axis labels. 4.5:1 on surface in every theme. HeroUI --muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, ··· buttons, dashed Rest days. HeroUI --border.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and chart grid lines. HeroUI --separator.

tokens.name: default
tokens.usage: Secondary button and neutral chip fill. HeroUI --default.

tokens.name: default-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on default. HeroUI --default-foreground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view: Enter a Round, Save Round, Publish. Orange on web and phone; lime in Range. HeroUI --accent.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent. Dark on orange (6.9:1); white on the light-theme orange. HeroUI --accent-foreground.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent fill: hover rows, tertiary buttons. HeroUI --accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft. HeroUI --accent-soft-foreground.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Selection that is not an action: today in the Weekly Plan, Level up, active admin sub-nav, Level pips. gtrack token (Tailwind bg-highlight).

tokens.name: highlight-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: segment
tokens.usage: Selected pill in Tabs and ToggleButtonGroup (the white nav pill). HeroUI --segment.

tokens.name: segment-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on the selected segment. gtrack token; applied by the Tabs/ToggleButton override.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, offset 2px. Lime so it never reads as the orange action. HeroUI --focus.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links are foreground + underline. HeroUI --link.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, Online, uploaded. HeroUI --success.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Rules changed, LLM cap reached, Offline. HeroUI --warning.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete Round, Abandon session, delete account, field errors. HeroUI --danger.

tokens.name: danger-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: field-background
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, OTP slots, text areas. HeroUI --field-background.

tokens.name: field-foreground
tokens.usage: Typed text. HeroUI --field-foreground.

tokens.name: field-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, 4.5:1 on field-background. HeroUI --field-placeholder.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: 1px field outline at rest; focus swaps it for focus. HeroUI --field-border.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb. HeroUI --scrollbar.

tokens.name: sg-positive
tokens.usage: Strokes Gained above the Baseline (+1.05). Always with the + sign: colour reinforces, never carries.

tokens.name: sg-negative
tokens.usage: Strokes Gained below the Baseline (−2.10). Always with the − sign.

tokens.name: sg-zero
tokens.usage: Exactly 0.00.

tokens.name: cat-ott
tokens.usage: SG Category Off the Tee (OTT). Badge fill, chart line, split band.

tokens.name: cat-app
tokens.usage: SG Category Approach (APP).

tokens.name: cat-shg
tokens.usage: SG Category Short Game (SHG).

tokens.name: cat-put
tokens.usage: SG Category Putting (PUT).

tokens.name: cat-foreground
tokens.usage: The three-letter code on any cat-* badge.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Resting bars and the Last 20 dashed line; the current bar takes accent or a cat-* colour.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page: the page title or the hero card. Instrument Serif, never bold.

styles.name: hero-sm
styles.usage: Page title at phone width and on secondary pages.

styles.name: live-score
styles.usage: The score in a live Practice Session (Range theme). Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Card stat, SG input value, trend value.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hit one ball to each target, nearest first.
styles.usage: Body copy, rules text, list rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, buttons at 14–16px use the same weight.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badge codes and axis labels only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip; pip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills in nav and chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row: badge, label, value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in the bento grid; phone page padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Web card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Web page side padding; hero card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a new page section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Design-system and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: SG Category badges, Level chips, kbd.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: HeroUI --radius base. HeroUI derives --field-radius = radius x 1.5 = 12px.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav pills, segmented controls: every control. Matches HeroUI --field-radius.

tokens.name: radius-live
tokens.usage: Live session buttons (Cleared, pad keys), 14–16px.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Tiles inside a card: rows, Weekly Plan days, inset panels.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, connection chip, Level pips only.

shadow.note: Cards are flat tonal steps with no shadow. Shadows only on overlays.

tokens.name: overlay-shadow
tokens.usage: Modal, popover, dropdown, toast. HeroUI --overlay-shadow.

tokens.name: surface-shadow
tokens.usage: None: cards are flat. HeroUI --surface-shadow.

tokens.name: field-shadow
tokens.usage: None: fields use field-border. HeroUI --field-shadow.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: ··· card menu, range pills.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default web control height and minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Form inputs and Save buttons.

tokens.name: control-live
tokens.usage: Minimum live-session target; primary live action 96–128px.
